_comment: Corrections applied on top of uk_rail.tiplocs when mapping TIPLOC -> CRS.
'drop' removes mappings that are wrong: ILFENBP is a London Underground
timing point that the source file maps to Newbury Racecourse.
'phantom' adds infrastructure-only TIPLOCs that appear in the track
geometry but never in Darwin service data. Each points at the nearest real
station's CRS, all validated within 0.15 km, so that a service genuinely
running over the section can still match it.
